title: AD Recycle Bin is not enabled
detail: Deleted objects cannot be restored with attributes/links intact without an authoritative restore.
recommendation: Plan enablement via change control (irreversible, forest-wide).

title: Forest functional level is Windows2012R2Forest
recommendation: Plan FFL/DFL uplift after all DCs run a supported OS (irreversible change - change control required).

title: Domain controller not reachable on core ports
recommendation: Verify DC is online, NTDS/KDC/Netlogon running, and firewall path from collector host. Later per-DC checks are skipped for this DC.

title: Clock skew 95 s vs localhost
recommendation: Check W32Time source and NT5DS hierarchy on this DC.

title: DC runs Windows Server 2016 Standard (extended support ends 2027-01-12)
recommendation: Plan replacement before end of extended support.

title: DC runs unsupported OS (Windows Server 2012 R2 Standard)
recommendation: Prioritize DC replacement (promote new DC on supported OS, transfer roles, demote).

title: Replication failing or lagging (30 h, 12 consecutive failures)
recommendation: Map the error code (e.g. 8453 access denied, 1722 RPC unavailable, 8606 lingering objects) and investigate the link.

title: Replication failure from DC1 (error 8606, 12 failures)
recommendation: Use repadmin /showrepl <dc> for per-NC status; 8606/8614 require lingering-object remediation plan.

title: SYSVOL share not accessible
detail: DC will not advertise as a DC / GPOs and logon scripts unavailable from this DC.
recommendation: Check SysvolReady registry value and DFSR state (event log DFS Replication).

title: NETLOGON share not accessible
detail: DC will not advertise as a DC / GPOs and logon scripts unavailable from this DC.
recommendation: Check SysvolReady registry value and DFSR state (event log DFS Replication).

title: SYSVOL share not accessible
detail: DC will not advertise as a DC / GPOs and logon scripts unavailable from this DC.
recommendation: Check SysvolReady registry value and DFSR state (event log DFS Replication).

title: NETLOGON share not accessible
detail: DC will not advertise as a DC / GPOs and logon scripts unavailable from this DC.
recommendation: Check SysvolReady registry value and DFSR state (event log DFS Replication).

title: Writable DC missing from _ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs SRV records
recommendation: Check Netlogon registration (netlogon.dns, event 5774/5781) - clients cannot locate this DC.

title: SRV records point to hosts that are not current DCs
recommendation: Stale locator records send clients to decommissioned DCs; validate metadata cleanup and DNS scavenging.

title: DNS on this DC is missing 1 DC locator record(s)
recommendation: Indicates AD-integrated zone replication or registration inconsistency between DNS servers.

title: DNS on this DC is missing 1 DC locator record(s)
recommendation: Indicates AD-integrated zone replication or registration inconsistency between DNS servers.

title: Last backup 12 days ago
recommendation: Verify backup jobs for system state on DCs in this NC.

title: Trust not configured for AES
recommendation: RC4 across trusts is being deprecated; plan AES enablement.

title: 1 site(s) have no subnets
recommendation: Clients cannot be mapped to these sites; remove or assign subnets.

title: 1 subnet(s) not associated with a site
1 site(s) have no DC (clients use site coverage / next closest)
krbtgt password is 900 days old
recommendation: Plan a staged double rotation (allow full replication + max ticket lifetime between resets) under change control.

title: Schema Admins is not empty (1)
recommendation: Keep empty except during approved schema changes.

title: Privileged accounts with SPNs (kerberoastable Tier-0)
recommendation: Remove SPNs from privileged users or move services to gMSA.

title: Privileged accounts with password never expires
recommendation: Enforce rotation or vault-managed credentials.

title: Privileged accounts with password older than 365 days
recommendation: Rotate credentials.

title: Privileged accounts inactive > 90 days
recommendation: Disable/remove unused privileged accounts (change control).

title: adminCount=1 accounts not found in in-scope protected groups (possible orphans)
recommendation: Verify (cross-domain/universal group membership is not expanded), then clear adminCount and restore ACL inheritance under change control.

title: Privileged accounts not in Protected Users
recommendation: Evaluate Protected Users for interactive admin accounts (test first: breaks NTLM/delegation).

title: Default minimum password length is 8 (< 14)
No account lockout threshold configured
recommendation: Password spraying is unthrottled. Evaluate lockout or smart lockout equivalents.

title: ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota is 10 (any user can join computers)
recommendation: Set to 0 and delegate join rights to specific groups (enables several RBCD/relay attack paths otherwise).

title: Enabled user accounts inactive > 90 days
recommendation: Disable after owner validation (change control); feeds attack surface and licensing.

title: Enabled accounts not requiring Kerberos pre-authentication (AS-REP roastable)
recommendation: Require pre-auth unless a documented legacy dependency exists.

title: Active computers on unsupported legacy OS (XP/Vista/7/8/2003/2008/2012)
recommendation: Isolate, upgrade or retire; confirm ESU coverage where applicable.

title: Active Windows computers without a LAPS-managed password
recommendation: Extend LAPS policy scope; note expiration attribute may be unreadable if collector lacks rights (verify on a sample).

title: Collection gap: TIME-002 error - area NOT verified
detail: Check failed: w32tm.exe not found on collector host (install RSAT AD DS tools).
recommendation: Fix permissions/connectivity for the collector identity; do not treat this area as healthy.

title: Collection gap: REPL-003 partial - area NOT verified
detail: repadmin failing links: 0; cmdlet-derived failing findings: 2
recommendation: Fix permissions/connectivity for the collector identity; do not treat this area as healthy.
